rationale: The file contains a consensus-critical nondeterminism vulnerability. At L155 in the `buyByAddress` function, `time.Now().Unix()` is used to set the `Time` field of a `Transaction` struct that is subsequently written to the ledger via `writeTransaction()` (L157), which calls `stub.PutState()` (L189). Additionally, package-level mutable globals `homeNo` (L16) and `transactionNo` (L17) are incremented after ledger writes (L109, L158), influencing the transaction ID written to state. These nondeterministic sources (wall-clock time and global counter state) can cause different endorsers to produce divergent ledger writes, violating consensus.
